body:
## Pull request overview

Adds a new `/playground` page to the site for interactive ObjectUI JSON schema editing with a live `SchemaRenderer` preview, and surfaces it via navigation/CTA updates.

**Changes:**
- Added Monaco editor dependency to the site package.
- Implemented `/playground` route with example schemas, live JSON editing, and preview rendering.
- Added “Playground” links to the docs header nav and homepage CTA.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 4 out of 5 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| pnpm-lock.yaml | Locks `@monaco-editor/react` for the site workspace. |
| apps/site/package.json | Adds `@monaco-editor/react` dependency needed by the playground page. |
| apps/site/lib/layout.shared.tsx | Adds “Playground” link to the docs/site header navigation config. |
| apps/site/app/playground/page.tsx | New playground route with Monaco editor, examples, theme switching, and live preview. |
| apps/site/app/(home)/page.tsx | Adds homepage CTA link to `/playground`. |
</details>


<details>
<summary>Files not reviewed (1)</summary>

* **pnpm-lock.yaml**: Language not supported
</details>

PR description mentions JSON auto-formatting, but the Monaco options here don't enable formatting behaviors (e.g., format-on-paste / format-on-type) or provide an explicit "Format" action. Either add the relevant Monaco options / command, or update the PR description to match the current behavior.
